text: I’m honestly disappointed with my recent visit to McDonald’s. I ordered a Fanta Float, expecting that creamy mix of cold orange soda and a good swirl of ice cream on top — but what I got was almost just plain Fanta with a sad little blob of melted ice cream floating in it. It looked nothing like the picture on the menu. That’s not acceptable from a brand like McDonald’s that’s supposed to maintain standards. The whole experience felt rushed and careless. I hope they actually start checking how these items are being prepared because this was genuinely disappointing.
author: Jasmine Shubaily

text:
I’ve noticed that the service at the takeaway counter has been consistently below expectations. The staff member at the counter often struggles to answer customers’ questions, and basic essentials like tissue paper and tomato sauce are frequently missing. This has been an ongoing issue for over a year, which makes the experience frustrating and inconvenient.

I’d kindly suggest assigning someone who is more knowledgeable, presenting , and attentive to customer needs at the counter to ensure a smoother and more pleasant experience for everyone.
Thank you.
